item.description:
Anastacia "#Ntk25 Anastacia Live in Concert"
Dolby Atmos Music



For the first time in her career, Anastacia is releasing a live album! #NTK25 - Live in Concert was recorded during her acclaimed NOT THAT KIND tour in 2025 – pure power, soul and voice. With all her hits from I'm Outta Love to Left Outside Alone, she thrills her fans with emotion, energy and pure passion.
